items.title: US says it has sunk multiple Iranian boats, Trump issues fresh warning
items.description: A large fire has also broken out at the key UAE oil port Fujairah, after it was hit by an Iranian drone attack. Follow live.

items.title: Capital gains tax, negative gearing and trusts to form budget tax trio
items.description: The government is still finalising the details of its budget, but several sources say three tax policies that featured in Labor's 2019 election campaign will be revived and rethought.

items.title: RBA facing 'lesser-of-two-evils' choice between recession or inflation
items.description: If there's any certainty about the RBA's interest rate verdict, it's that it will be a split decision.

items.title: NDIS rorts cost taxpayers $8b a year. This is how they happen
items.description: Insiders and participants say the NDIS is being targeted in similar ways around the country, including billing for services not provided, overcharging and in some cases "kidnapping" of vulnerable clients in order to park them in expensive supported accommodation and drain their plans.

items.title: Alice Springs 5yo's alleged murderer's first court appearance streamed live
items.description: Jefferson Lewis will face court for the first time this morning, with the hearing in the Alice Springs Local Court to be streamed live online.

items.title: Warning of 'tsunami of chronic disease' as dialysis units ration care
items.description: Dialysis units across Australia and New Zealand are being forced to ration lifesaving care for patients with kidney failure, according to a major new report which has warned of a "significant threat" to patient safety.

items.title: Three dead in boating accident off NSW coast as search for survivors continues
items.description: Marine Rescue NSW responds to a yacht in distress but its vessel rolls in heavy conditions.

items.title: Electric vehicle tax discount to be wound back from next year
items.description: A popular tax discount meaning people leasing electric vehicles did not have to pay Fringe Benefits Tax will be wound back — although in the long term, more EV owners will be able to pay a reduced tax rate.

items.title: How did this boy from the bush become head of the highest court in the land?
items.description: The High Court makes decisions that impact us every day. So who is Stephen Gageler, the person overseeing it all? And how did he get here from a tiny town in regional NSW?

items.title: World order could be 'rebuilt out of Europe', Carney says
items.description: The Canadian prime minister tells European leaders the world does not need to submit to a "more transactional and insular world".

items.title: Sydney Lord Mayor Clover Moore cancels 'globalise the intifada' forum
items.description: The event's cancellation is welcomed by groups representing the Jewish community in New South Wales.

items.title: Teen left behind after Vanuatu earthquake sues Commonwealth
items.description: A teenager with multiple disabilities stranded for days in Vanuatu's capital city after a deadly 2024 earthquake is taking the Australian government to the federal court for disability discrimination.

items.title: Cruise ship banned from port after three die in suspected virus outbreak
items.description: Three people have died and three people are ill after a suspected outbreak of the rodent-borne virus in the Atlantic Ocean.

items.title: What Luai's shock NRL move could mean for Australian and NZ rugby union
items.description: The NRL's expansion has ramifications for more than the existing 17 clubs, with Australian and New Zealand rugby talent also in the crosshairs.

items.title: Australia urged to start providing cooked lunches in schools
items.description: Tasmania is "leading the way" with its largely state government-funded school lunch program. Now advocates are calling for a national rollout of the scheme, but warn parents may need to chip in.

items.title: Met Gala quiz: Guess who wore these outfits to fashion's best party
items.description: From Ariana to Zendaya, we're testing your knowledge of some of the most exceptional and extreme fashion on show at recent Met Galas.

items.title: Australia is experiencing HRT menopause patch shortages. Here's why
items.description: Supplies of some HRT patches may not return to normal until at least the end of the year. So what can patients do if they're impacted by shortages?

items.title: Vietnam's 135,000-seat gold stadium points to something even bigger
items.description: The country announced more than 500 infrastructure projects last year alone, totalling $280 billion, as it pushes ahead with an ambitious plan to revolutionise its economy.

items.title: Who pays to put food on the table during a global crisis?
items.description: As the price of food and agricultural production goes up during the Iran conflict, supermarkets are being urged to absorb more of the cost.

items.title: Church ordains man facing rape charge interstate as a deacon
items.description: A man who is facing a rape charge in Queensland — which he has pleaded not guilty to — has been appointed to a leadership role in a Tasmanian Seventh-day Adventist church.

items.title: Trains are running to a weekend timetable this week - what you need to know
items.description: Commuters have been warned to expect "more crowded" trains as a reduced timetable begins, with no end in sight.

items.title: Bishop ordered to resign over relationship with priest appealing decision
items.description: One of South Australia's most senior Anglicans is stripped of his position over an undisclosed relationship with a priest he ordained, in a case described by the church as "a gross ethical failure".

items.title: Law, order and $1b surplus form pillars of Labor's upcoming Victorian budget
items.description: The government has pledged to invest heavily in a crime crackdown and deliver a surplus in its upcoming 2026/27 state budget.

items.title: Three main issues set to sway voters in Qld by-election
items.description: Residents in the north Brisbane seat of Stafford are set to cast their votes in a by-election dominated by cost-of-living concerns.

items.title: Accused underworld shooters far from trained assassins, defence argues
items.description: Lawyers for two men accused of murdering underworld figure Gavin Preston tell a jury their clients did not have the skills required to carry out a well-planned execution.
